about: SCION 07 trace: measured from the geometry drawn in each scene frame (centroid of the torso contour, body points 1-10, withers to chest; the neck points are bound to the head and left out; head and withers heights, extents against the door frame). state is the dog's choice as scheduled from the score; facing is the gaze of the drawn head key (1 toward the door and the person, -1 back turned).
